title: Karuppu Nila
desc: After his father is falsely accused of aiding terrorists, Shanmuga Pandian's girlfriend leaves him. However, he joins forces with Nandhini and battles against all odds to clear his father's name.

title: Kadalora Kavithaigal
desc: A teacher's heart is captured by a rough criminal. She believes love can transform even the most difficult soul, and sets out to prove it through their unexpected romance.

title: Meenava Nanban
desc: Kumaran, a brave adventurer, arrives to assist the fishermen, who were being taken advantage of by Nagaraj, an avaricious man.

title: Poi
desc: Valluvanar is an honest politician. When his son Kamban is arrested, he refuses to bail him out of jail. The opposition party takes advantage of the situation and thus helps Kamban escape from jail.

title: Priyamudan
desc: Vasanth, the son of a wealthy businessman, falls in love with Priya when he visits Rajasthan. He impersonates a man named Vasanth Kumar, who had saved her life before, in order to woo her.
